key.name: profiles-dir
key.description: Directory containing .ovpn profile files. A leading ~ is expanded to the user's home directory at runtime.

key.name: interactive-config
key.description: JSON array configuring interactive OpenVPN inputs per profile. Each entry contains vpn and inputs, where inputs is an ordered list of objects: input, type (static|prompt), and value.

key.name: debug-enabled
key.description: When enabled, a .ovpn.log file is created next to each profile during connection attempts. The log includes expect/spawn output and extension-side errors related to that profile.
